cases.title: Educational Credential Assessment Report - World Education Services

fields.foreign_credential_name: Master of Science in Data Science

narrative_blocks: This Educational Credential Assessment (ECA) report was evaluated by World Education Services (WES) for Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) Express Entry purposes.
Credential Evaluation Summary: The Master of Science in Data Science awarded by the University of Manchester in 2018 has been evaluated as equivalent to a Canadian Master's degree.
Verification Status: Authentic electronic document verified directly against official academic transcripts supplied by the issuing institution.

cases.title: Educational Credential Assessment Report - Expired 5-Year Validity
narrative_blocks: This Educational Credential Assessment (ECA) report was issued by World Education Services (WES) on January 10, 2019.
The evaluation report exceeded the maximum 5-year validity threshold for IRCC immigration submission as of the submission date in 2026.
Because the ECA report has expired, 0 Express Entry Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) points can be awarded for this credential until a re-issuance or new assessment is completed.

defect_spec.description: The ECA report issue date (2019-01-10) exceeds the 5-year validity window required by IRCC for immigration applications as of July 2026, rendering the report expired and ineligible for CRS points calculation.

mutation_details.impact: ECA report expired prior to application submission; CRS points set to 0.

cases.title: Educational Credential Assessment Report - Unrecognized Foreign Credential
cases.issuing_authority: International Credential Assessment Service of Canada (ICAS)

fields.issuing_organization: International Credential Assessment Service of Canada (ICAS)
fields.canadian_equivalency_summary: No Canadian Equivalency - Institution is not recognized or accredited by the authority in its home jurisdiction

narrative_blocks: Assessment Result: The credential submitted from Global Online Unaccredited Institute was reviewed by ICAS.
Evaluation Findings: The issuing institution is not accredited or recognized by the national education ministry or competent regional accrediting authority in the country of origin.
Canadian Equivalency Outcome: Unable to establish Canadian educational equivalency. No educational points under Express Entry can be claimed.

defect_spec.description: The evaluated foreign educational institution is unaccredited and unrecognized by national education authorities, resulting in no Canadian equivalency rating.

cases.title: Educational Credential Assessment Report - Non-Designated Issuing Body

fields.foreign_credential_name: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering

narrative_blocks: This credential evaluation was conducted by Global Academic Evaluation Agency Corp. for general employment and resume verification.
Notice regarding IRCC Designation: Global Academic Evaluation Agency Corp. is NOT an IRCC-designated organization for Express Entry Educational Credential Assessment.
This document is an evaluation for general employment purposes and cannot be accepted for Canadian economic immigration programs.

defect_spec.description: The report was issued by an unauthorized private evaluation organization ('Global Academic Evaluation Agency Corp.') rather than an IRCC-designated ECA body, and uses a standard employment report type instead of an IRCC assessment.

mutation_details.original_issuing_organization: Comparative Education Service (CES) - University of Toronto
